name: Science
description: Comprehensive Science syllabus for the District Selection Committee (DSC) examination, covering Class III to VIII content (with difficulty up to Class X) and Science Methodology.

topics.name: Living World
topics.description: Characteristics, diversity, structures, and habits of living organisms including plants, animals, humans, cells, and basic social/recreational units.

subtopics.name: Plants and Animals Diversity
subtopics.description: Classification, characteristics, habitats, adaptations, and behaviors of plants and animals.

concepts.name: Living vs Non-Living & Plant Classification
concepts.description: Characteristics of living organisms and classification of plants based on size (herbs, shrubs, trees) and habitat (terrestrial, aquatic, desert).
concepts.learning_objective: Differentiate living and non-living things and categorize plants based on growth habit and habitat.

concepts.name: Plant Parts and Functions
concepts.description: Structure and biological functions of root, stem, leaf, flower, fruit, and seeds.
concepts.learning_objective: Identify plant organs and explain their functional roles in plant survival.

concepts.name: Animal Classification and Feeding Habits
concepts.description: Classification of animals into oviparous/viviparous, herbivores/carnivores/omnivores, domestic/wild.
concepts.learning_objective: Classify animals by reproductive mode, diet type, and domestic status.

concepts.name: Animal Habitats, Adaptations, Sounds, and Movements
concepts.description: Different habitats, structural adaptations, animal sounds, locomotion methods, and bird features like beaks and nests.
concepts.learning_objective: Explain animal adaptations to habitats, modes of movement, vocalizations, and bird features.

subtopics.name: Human Body, Health, and Safety
subtopics.description: Human anatomy, skeletal and muscular systems, sense organs, health habits, safe/unsafe touch, and first aid.

concepts.name: Human Skeletal and Muscular Systems
concepts.description: Bones, joints, cartilage, and muscle interactions providing structure and movement.
concepts.learning_objective: Describe the skeletal structure, types of joints, cartilage, and muscular function.

concepts.name: Sense Organs and Hygiene
concepts.description: Functions and care of eye, ear, nose, tongue, skin; personal hygiene and sensitivity to differently abled persons.
concepts.learning_objective: Demonstrate care for sense organs and awareness toward differently abled individuals.

concepts.name: Safety, Hazards, and First Aid
concepts.description: Safety measures at home, school, road, water hazards, personal safety (good touch/bad touch), and basic first aid.
concepts.learning_objective: Apply safety protocols, identify child safety boundaries, and administer basic first aid.

subtopics.name: Food, Nutrition, and Agricultural Practices
subtopics.description: Sources, preparation, components, deficiency diseases, preservation, and crop production methods.

concepts.name: Food Sources, Components, and Balanced Diet
concepts.description: Nutritional components (carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, minerals), balanced diet, and junk food hazards.
concepts.learning_objective: Identify food nutrients, construct a balanced diet, and explain risks of junk food.

concepts.name: Deficiency Diseases and Food Preservation
concepts.description: Malnutrition, vitamin/mineral deficiency diseases, food cooking methods, wastage prevention, and preservation techniques.
concepts.learning_objective: Recognize deficiency symptoms and apply food preservation methods.

concepts.name: Agricultural Practices, Tools, and Food Storage
concepts.description: Steps in crop production (ploughing, sowing, irrigation, harvesting), farm tools, storage, and animal husbandry.
concepts.learning_objective: Detail agricultural procedures, agricultural implements, storage methods, and animal food sources.

subtopics.name: Cell Biology, Microorganisms, Family, and Recreation
subtopics.description: Cellular basics, microbiology, family dynamics, shelter types, and recreational activities.

concepts.name: Cell Structure and Function
concepts.description: Cell as basic unit of life, cell organelle structures, plant vs animal cells.
concepts.learning_objective: Explain cell theory, identify cell organelles, and distinguish plant from animal cells.

concepts.name: Microorganisms: Friends and Foes
concepts.description: Types of microorganisms (bacteria, fungi, protozoa, algae, viruses), beneficial uses, and harmful disease-causing pathogens.
concepts.learning_objective: Categorize microbes and distinguish between useful applications and pathogenic effects.

concepts.name: Family, Shelter, Migration, and Games
concepts.description: Family types/budgets, housing types, migration causes/effects, slums, and indoor/outdoor games.
concepts.learning_objective: Analyze family systems, socio-economic shelter challenges, and physical benefits of games.

topics.name: Life Processes
topics.description: Biological mechanisms in plants and animals including nutrition, respiration, circulation, excretion, coordination, and reproduction.

subtopics.name: Nutrition and Respiration
subtopics.description: Modes of nutrition and physiological mechanisms of gas exchange in plants and animals.

concepts.name: Plant Nutrition Modes
concepts.description: Autotrophic nutrition, photosynthesizing mechanisms, heterotrophic plants (parasitic, saprophytic, insectivorous).
concepts.learning_objective: Contrast autotrophic and heterotrophic plant nutrition mechanisms.

concepts.name: Digestion in Humans and Animals
concepts.description: Human digestive tract and process, digestion in ruminants (grass eaters), and pseudopodial ingestion in Amoeba.
concepts.learning_objective: Trace food movement in human alimentary canal, ruminant stomachs, and cellular digestion in Amoeba.

concepts.name: Respiration in Plants and Animals
concepts.description: Aerobic vs anaerobic respiration, cellular respiration, human respiratory system, stomatal exchange in plants.
concepts.learning_objective: Explain cellular respiration pathways and compare respiration mechanisms across species.

subtopics.name: Circulation, Excretion, and Neural Control
subtopics.description: Internal transport systems, waste elimination, and nervous system coordination.

concepts.name: Human Circulatory System and Plant Transport
concepts.description: Heart structure, blood composition, blood vessels, xylem/phloem transport in plants.
concepts.learning_objective: Describe human cardiac circulation and vascular transport in flora.

concepts.name: Excretory System in Animals
concepts.description: Waste removal mechanisms, human urinary system (kidneys, ureters, bladder, urethra).
concepts.learning_objective: Outline the human excretory pathways and metabolic waste elimination.

concepts.name: Nervous System and Coordination
concepts.description: Central and peripheral nervous systems, neurons, brain, spinal cord, reflex action.
concepts.learning_objective: Explain neural structure and reflex mechanisms handling sensory response.

subtopics.name: Reproduction, Adolescence, and Development
subtopics.description: Modes of reproduction, seed dispersal, human adolescence, hormonal regulation, and reproductive health.

concepts.name: Modes of Plant Reproduction & Seed Dispersal
concepts.description: Asexual techniques (budding, fragmentation, spore formation), vegetative propagation, sexual reproduction in flowers, seed dispersal agents.
concepts.learning_objective: Compare asexual/sexual reproduction in plants and explain seed dispersal methods.

concepts.name: Animal Reproduction and Metamorphosis
concepts.description: Sexual and asexual reproduction in animals, male/female reproductive systems, fertilization (internal/external), metamorphosis in frog/silkworm.
concepts.learning_objective: Detail animal reproductive organ systems and lifecycle developmental changes (metamorphosis).

concepts.name: Adolescence, Hormones, and Reproductive Health
concepts.description: Puberty changes, sex hormones, endocrine glands, sex determination in humans, reproductive hygiene.
concepts.learning_objective: Identify physical/hormonal changes during puberty, sex determination genetics, and hygiene practices.

topics.name: Matter and Materials
topics.description: Classification of materials, chemical substances, solutions, chemical transformations, fuels, and synthetic polymers.

subtopics.name: Properties of Matter and Separation Techniques
subtopics.description: Classification of objects, properties of metals and non-metals, reactivity series, and separation methods.

concepts.name: Classification and Properties of Materials
concepts.description: Grouping materials based on luster, hardness, transparency, solubility, density.
concepts.learning_objective: Classify common substances according to physical properties.

concepts.name: Metals and Non-Metals
concepts.description: Physical and chemical properties of metals/non-metals, reactivity series of metals, real-world applications.
concepts.learning_objective: Contrast metallic and non-metallic properties and predict reactions based on reactivity series.

concepts.name: Methods of Separation and Solutions
concepts.description: Filtration, evaporation, decantation, winnowing; saturated and unsaturated solutions, solubility limits.
concepts.learning_objective: Select appropriate separation techniques for mixtures and define solution saturation.

subtopics.name: Acids, Bases, Salts, and Chemical Reactions
subtopics.description: Acids, bases, indicators, neutralization reactions, physical vs chemical changes, and corrosion control.

concepts.name: Acids, Bases, and Neutralization
concepts.description: Properties of acids/bases, natural and synthetic indicators (litmus, turmeric, phenolphthalein), neutralization in daily life.
concepts.learning_objective: Identify acidic/basic substances using indicators and explain neutralization applications.

concepts.name: Physical and Chemical Changes
concepts.description: Reversible physical changes vs irreversible chemical changes, indications of chemical reactions.
concepts.learning_objective: Differentiate physical from chemical transformations with real-world examples.

concepts.name: Rusting of Iron and Crystallization
concepts.description: Causes of iron oxidation, protective methods (galvanization), process of crystallization.
concepts.learning_objective: Explain oxidation of metals, preventive galvanization, and pure crystal formation.

subtopics.name: Combustion, Energy Resources, Fibres, and Plastics
subtopics.description: Fossil fuels, fire safety, synthetic fibers, plastic types, and environmental impacts.

concepts.name: Combustion, Flame Structure, and Fire Control
concepts.description: Conditions for burning, ignition temperature, inflammable substances, flame zones/color, fire fighting methods.
concepts.learning_objective: Analyze requirements for combustion, structure of a candle flame, and fire control techniques.

concepts.name: Fossil Fuels, Petroleum Refining, and Conservation
concepts.description: Exhaustible/inexhaustible resources, formation and uses of coal/petroleum/natural gas, refining fractions, misuse effects.
concepts.learning_objective: Describe fossil fuel formation, petroleum refining fractions, and sustainable energy usage.

concepts.name: Natural & Synthetic Fibres and Plastics
concepts.description: Cotton, silk, wool, nylon, rayon, polyester, acrylic; thermoplastics vs thermosetting plastics; environmental degradation.
concepts.learning_objective: Categorize natural vs synthetic polymers and evaluate environmental impact of non-biodegradable plastics.

topics.name: Physical Phenomena
topics.description: Core concepts of physics including motion, force, friction, pressure, heat, optics, electricity, magnetism, sound, and natural disasters.

subtopics.name: Measurement, Motion, Force, and Pressure
subtopics.description: Units of length/time, motion types, speed calculation, forces, friction principles, and pressure dynamics.

concepts.name: Measurement, Motion, and Distance-Time Graphs
concepts.description: Standard SI units, non-standard units, rectiliener/circular/periodic motion, uniform/non-uniform motion, speed formula, distance-time graphs.
concepts.learning_objective: Measure distances accurately, calculate speed, and interpret distance-time graphs.

concepts.name: Force and Pressure Dynamics
concepts.description: Contact vs non-contact forces, net force, effects of force, fluid pressure, atmospheric pressure measurement.
concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish force types and calculate pressure exerted by solids, fluids, and atmosphere.

concepts.name: Friction: Characteristics and Control
concepts.description: Factors affecting friction, types (static, sliding, rolling, drag), advantages/disadvantages, techniques to modify friction.
concepts.learning_objective: Identify friction types and explain methods to increase or reduce friction in practical applications.

subtopics.name: Heat and Light
subtopics.description: Thermal energy transfer, light reflection, optical instruments, dispersion, and vision.

concepts.name: Heat, Temperature, and Thermal Transfer
concepts.description: Temperature scales/units, clinical and laboratory thermometers, conduction, convection, and radiation mechanisms.
concepts.learning_objective: Measure temperature accurately and differentiate heat transfer modes.

concepts.name: Light, Shadows, and Reflection
concepts.description: Transparent/opaque/translucent media, pinhole camera, laws of reflection, regular vs diffused reflection, plane mirror images.
concepts.learning_objective: Explain shadow formation, pinhole imaging, and reflection laws.

concepts.name: Spherical Mirrors, Lenses, Dispersion, and Human Eye
concepts.description: Concave/convex mirrors and lenses, spectrum dispersion through prism, human eye anatomy, vision defects, Braille system.
concepts.learning_objective: Detail image formation by spherical optics, dispersion of white light, and eye anatomy/care.

subtopics.name: Electricity, Magnetism, Sound, and Universe
subtopics.description: Electric circuits, magnetic properties, sound wave physics, natural electrical/tectonic phenomena, and astronomy.

concepts.name: Electricity, Circuits, and Chemical/Magnetic Effects
concepts.description: Circuit diagrams, conductors/insulators, heating effect (fuse, MCB, CFL, LED), magnetic effect (electromagnet, bell), electroplating.
concepts.learning_objective: Construct basic electric circuits and demonstrate heating, magnetic, and chemical effects of current.

concepts.name: Magnetism and Properties
concepts.description: Discovery of magnets, magnetic/non-magnetic materials, poles, attraction/repulsion, magnetic compass, proper storage.
concepts.learning_objective: Demonstrate magnetic properties, pole interactions, and directional compass usage.

concepts.name: Sound Physics and Wave Characteristics
concepts.description: Vibrational sound production, human ear mechanism, longitudinal/transverse waves, wavelength, frequency, amplitude, pitch, loudness, noise pollution.
concepts.learning_objective: Explain sound propagation, auditory perception, wave parameters, and noise pollution causes.

concepts.name: Natural Phenomena and Our Universe
concepts.description: Static electricity, lightning conductors, earthquakes/tsunamis, lunar phases, solar/lunar eclipses, solar system, constellations, artificial satellites.
concepts.learning_objective: Explain electrostatics, seismic activity, planetary motion, eclipses, and space technology.

topics.name: Transportation and Communication
topics.description: Evolution of travel, global trade networks, historical and modern communication methods, and socio-economic integration.

subtopics.name: Transportation Systems and Global Trade
subtopics.description: History of transport, traffic signage, modes across terrains (hills, deserts, water), import/export, tourism.

concepts.name: Modes and Adaptation of Transport
concepts.description: Historical evolution of vehicles, signs/symbols, specialized transport for hilly, desert, forest, and aquatic terrains.
concepts.learning_objective: Trace transport history and identify transit modes suited to distinct topographies.

concepts.name: International Transport, Goods, and Tourism
concepts.description: Freight transit, import/export dynamics, global economic connectivity, tourism, and Seven Wonders of the World.
concepts.learning_objective: Explain international trade transport mechanics and economic benefits of tourism.

subtopics.name: Communication Systems and Global Integration
subtopics.description: Human/animal signaling, historical mail systems, modern digital communication media, mass media, global shrinking.

concepts.name: Types and Evolution of Communication
concepts.description: Gestural communication in animals/humans, historical postal systems, transitions to electronic communication.
concepts.learning_objective: Compare expressive communication modes across human history and animal behavior.

concepts.name: Mass Media, Digital Tools, and World Connectivity
concepts.description: Impact of radio, TV, cell phones, email, social media, newspapers; how transport and communication create a global village.
concepts.learning_objective: Evaluate mass communication media and summarize how connectivity bridges global distances.

topics.name: Professions, Services, and Governance
topics.description: Societal occupations, essential village and urban helping agencies, local governance structures, and public services.

subtopics.name: Professions, Helper Agencies, and Governance
subtopics.description: Trades, agricultural assistance agencies, public utilities, and tiers of government.

concepts.name: Occupations and Household Tools
concepts.description: Roles of farmers, cobblers, tailors, artisans; specialized tools and household materials associated with professions.
concepts.learning_objective: Identify key community occupations and match tools/materials to their specific trades.

concepts.name: Public Helping Institutions and Rural Support
concepts.description: Role of banks, E-Seva centers, Primary Health Centers (PHCs), Gram Panchayat offices, post offices.
concepts.learning_objective: Describe functions of essential public service institutions supporting rural and urban communities.

concepts.name: Governance Structures and Services
concepts.description: Organization and duties of Local Self Government, State Government, Central Government, and the Judiciary.
concepts.learning_objective: Outline the three-tiered government architecture and judicial function in public administration.

topics.name: Our Environment
topics.description: Atmospheric dynamics, climate change, air quality, water resource management, sewage treatment, biodiversity, and conservation.

subtopics.name: Climate Change, Atmosphere, and Air Quality
subtopics.description: Weather, extreme climatic events, global environmental degradation, atmospheric composition, nitrogen cycle, air pollution.

concepts.name: Weather, Climate, and Global Issues
concepts.description: Weather parameters, rain/floods/cyclones, disaster management, greenhouse effect, global warming, acid rain.
concepts.learning_objective: Analyze climate events, mechanisms of global warming/acid rain, and disaster mitigation strategies.

concepts.name: Air Composition, Nitrogen Cycle, and Air Pollution
concepts.description: Components of air, properties, oxygen cycle, atmospheric nitrogen fixation cycle, air pollutants (causes, effects, prevention).
concepts.learning_objective: Explain gas cycles in the atmosphere and formulate measures to mitigate air pollution.

subtopics.name: Water Resources, Management, and Sanitation
subtopics.description: Water cycle, freshwater sources in AP, water conservation, pollution control, sewage management, and sanitation.

concepts.name: Water Properties, Water Cycle, and Local Rivers
concepts.description: Physical forms/properties of water, hydrologic cycle, major rivers of Andhra Pradesh, droughts and floods.
concepts.learning_objective: Detail the water cycle and evaluate local river ecosystems and hydrological challenges.

concepts.name: Water Conservation, Pollution, and Safe Drinking Water
concepts.description: Tank management, rain water harvesting, causes/effects of water contamination, purification of drinking water.
concepts.learning_objective: Outline water conservation methods and potable water purification techniques.

concepts.name: Sewage Management, Wastewater Treatment, and Sanitation
concepts.description: Wastewater sources, sewage treatment process, household sanitation practices, alternative sewage disposal options.
concepts.learning_objective: Explain wastewater treatment steps and sanitary waste management practices.

subtopics.name: Biodiversity, Forests, and Conservation
subtopics.description: Forest ecosystems, flora/fauna interactions, deforestation consequences, conservation movements, protected areas.

concepts.name: Forest Ecosystems and Interdependence
concepts.description: Flora and fauna of forests, ecosystem services, green cover benefits, ecological balance.
concepts.learning_objective: Explain ecological interrelationships among forest organisms and systemic benefits of forests.

concepts.name: Deforestation, Conservation, and Wildlife Protection
concepts.description: Causes/effects of deforestation, Chipko Movement, national parks/sanctuaries, endangered and endemic species.
concepts.learning_objective: Assess environmental threats of deforestation and detail strategies for wildlife preservation.

topics.name: Science Methodology
topics.description: Pedagogical principles, curriculum design, learning objectives, instructional methods, laboratory management, and evaluation in teaching Science.

subtopics.name: Foundations, Aims, and Standards of Science Education
subtopics.description: Nature and history of science, aims, academic standards, specifications, and curriculum design.

concepts.name: Nature, Scope, and History of Science
concepts.description: Epistemology of science, historical development of scientific thought, scope in contemporary education.
concepts.learning_objective: Understand the philosophical nature, broad scope, and historical milestones of science.

concepts.name: Aims, Values, Academic Standards, and Objectives
concepts.description: Values of science teaching (utilitarian, cultural, disciplinary), instructional objectives, academic standards.
concepts.learning_objective: Formulate behavioral objectives and align teaching with established academic standards.

concepts.name: Science Curriculum and Textbook Analysis
concepts.description: Principles of science curriculum construction, textbook evaluation, criteria of good science textbooks.
concepts.learning_objective: Critique science textbooks and explain principles of sound science curriculum design.

subtopics.name: Teaching Methods, TLM, and Planning
subtopics.description: Pedagogical approaches, improvised aids, laboratory setup, lesson/year planning, and teacher role.

concepts.name: Methods, Approaches, and Techniques of Teaching Science
concepts.description: Inductive-deductive, lecture-demonstration, heuristic, project, inquiry-based, 5E learning model approaches.
concepts.learning_objective: Select and implement appropriate teaching methods based on science topic demands.

concepts.name: TLM, Improvised Aids, and Science Laboratories
concepts.description: Audio-visual aids, low-cost improvised teaching learning materials, science lab layout, safety rules, equipment management.
concepts.learning_objective: Design low-cost teaching aids and effectively organize/manage a school science laboratory.

concepts.name: Instructional Planning and Role of Science Teacher
concepts.description: Year plan, unit plan, lesson plan formulation, responsibilities, competencies, and professional growth of a science teacher.
concepts.learning_objective: Construct detailed lesson plans and describe professional competencies of a science teacher.

subtopics.name: Assessment, Evaluation, and Science Activities
subtopics.description: Continuous comprehensive evaluation, test construction, science clubs, fairs, field trips, and museums.

concepts.name: Assessment and Evaluation in Science
concepts.description: Formative and summative assessment, Continuous Comprehensive Evaluation (CCE), diagnostic testing, remedial teaching, blue print design.
concepts.learning_objective: Develop balanced assessment tools (CCE, scholastic/co-scholastic) and remedial strategies.

concepts.name: Co-Curricular Activities in Science
concepts.description: Organization and educational benefits of Science Fairs, Science Clubs, Field Trips, and Science Museums.
concepts.learning_objective: Plan and conduct out-of-classroom science activities to foster scientific temper.
